subject: design/routing-evidence-v1
statement: Proposal/report/tracker payloads and measurement datasets are deterministic projections from canonical events. A projection carries event IDs, evidence-ref proof, and its own digest. Acceptance exact-reads canonical events and rejects missing, stale, extra, or field-different faces.
